questions.question: What is said about the value of this treatise even though it has weaknesses and is hard for some people to understand?
questions.answer: It is presented as highly important despite those problems.

questions.question: Which respected figure is mentioned as having foretold this work and honored it with special names?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What two titles are given to this treatise or this part of the larger collection?
questions.answer: It is called the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: How is Imam Ali’s attitude toward this work described?
questions.answer: He is shown as favoring it especially and drawing people’s attention to it.

questions.question: What event is mentioned as confirming Imam Ali’s prediction?
questions.answer: The events connected to Denizli are said to confirm it.

questions.question: What led to the imprisonment mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: The hidden printing of the book led to it.

questions.question: What is given as a major reason for acquittal and release?
questions.answer: The victory of the book’s sacred and powerful truth is given as the main reason.

questions.question: How is the Supreme Sign connected to a Qur’anic verse?
questions.answer: It is described as a true explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: How is the work organized?
questions.answer: It has an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What does the Introduction contain?
questions.answer: It presents four important matters.

questions.question: What is found in the First Station?
questions.answer: It contains the Arabic part of the explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What is included in the Second Station?
questions.answer: It gives the translation of that explanation along with its proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about the length of the Introduction?
questions.answer: It became longer than intended because there was a real need for that length.

questions.question: What central purpose of jinn and mankind is highlighted by the Qur’anic verse at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Their purpose is to worship Allah.

questions.question: What main idea opens this passage about the treatise after the earlier difficulties are mentioned?
questions.answer: The passage begins by stressing that the work remains very important.

questions.question: Why are the names given by Imam Ali significant in this passage?
questions.answer: They are used to show honor, spiritual importance, and a kind of foreknowledge about the work.

questions.question: What does the passage imply by saying people’s attention was directed toward this part of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It implies this section deserves special notice and careful reading.

questions.question: In the note about Denizli, what two opposite outcomes are linked to the book?
questions.answer: It is linked first to imprisonment and then to acquittal and release.

questions.question: How does the note use those outcomes to strengthen its claim?
questions.answer: It presents those events as matching the earlier prediction and therefore supporting it.

questions.question: Besides being called the Supreme Sign, what other place does this work have within the larger collection?
questions.answer: It is also identified as the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Supreme Sign explains?
questions.answer: It explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What are the three main structural parts named in the passage?
questions.answer: The Introduction, the First Station, and the Second Station.

questions.question: How are the two Stations different from each other?
questions.answer: The first gives the Arabic exposition, while the second gives its translation and supporting evidence.

questions.question: How does the writer explain the unexpectedly long Introduction?
questions.answer: He says it grew that way because there was a need for it, not because he wanted to make it long.

questions.question: What balanced view does the writer give about the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: Some may think it is too long, while others may think it is still too short.

questions.question: What effect does ending the passage with a Qur’anic verse have on the tone?
questions.answer: It gives the passage a serious, worship-centered, and sacred tone.

questions.question: According to that verse, what is the basic reason jinn and human beings were created?
questions.answer: They were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: What overall picture of the treatise does the passage give?
questions.answer: It presents the treatise as a respected, carefully arranged, spiritually important work centered on guiding people to worship.

questions.question: How does the passage respond to concerns about the treatise’s defects and difficulties?
questions.answer: It says those concerns do not lessen its great importance.

questions.question: What does the passage attribute to Imam Ali regarding this work?
questions.answer: It attributes to him a miraculous foretelling of its coming.

questions.question: Why might giving special names to the work matter for readers?
questions.answer: It can make readers see the work as honored and worthy of attention.

questions.question: What is the meaning of saying this part of the Risale-i Nur received special favor?
questions.answer: It means it was regarded with particular approval and esteem.

questions.question: What role did the secret publication of the book play in the events mentioned?
questions.answer: It was the reason given for the imprisonment.

questions.question: What role did the truth of the book play afterward?
questions.answer: It was presented as a chief reason for being cleared and freed.

questions.question: What relationship does the passage draw between prediction and later events?
questions.answer: It says the later events verified the earlier prediction.

questions.question: How is the prayer linked to the discussion of prediction?
questions.answer: The events are presented as showing that the prayer made on their behalf was accepted.

questions.question: What does the passage identify the Supreme Sign as doing in relation to revelation?
questions.answer: It serves as a genuine explanation of a great Qur’anic verse.

questions.question: How many major sections does the treatise have?
questions.answer: Three main sections are named: one Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What does the Introduction include before the two Stations begin?
questions.answer: It includes four important matters.

questions.question: Why is the First Station distinct from the Second Station?
questions.answer: The first is the Arabic exposition itself, while the second is the translation with evidence.

questions.question: What can be understood from the writer’s statement that the long Introduction shows a need?
questions.answer: It means the subject required extended explanation for the readers’ benefit.

questions.question: Why might different readers judge the Introduction’s length differently?
questions.answer: Because people differ in what they need and in how much explanation they want.

questions.question: What essential teaching is brought forward by the Qur’anic verse at the end?
questions.answer: The central teaching is that jinn and mankind were created for worship.

questions.question: What contrast appears at the start of the passage regarding the treatise?
questions.answer: It has difficulties on one side, but great importance on the other.

questions.question: Who is presented as recognizing the treatise’s importance before its appearance?
questions.answer: Imam Ali is presented that way.

questions.question: What do the titles attached to the work suggest about its status?
questions.answer: They suggest that it has high spiritual rank and special meaning.

questions.question: What is one effect of saying people were directed to look at this work?
questions.answer: It encourages readers to pay close attention to it.

questions.question: Which city is named in connection with events that supported the claim about the work?
questions.answer: Denizli.

questions.question: What was the immediate consequence of printing the book secretly?
questions.answer: It brought about imprisonment.

questions.question: What later result is connected to the strength of the book’s truth?
questions.answer: It contributed to acquittal and release.

questions.question: How does the passage connect these legal events to a spiritual claim?
questions.answer: It treats them as signs that an earlier prediction and prayer were fulfilled.

questions.question: What two identities of the work are stated together in the passage?
questions.answer: It is both an exposition of the Supreme Verse and the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Introduction within the treatise’s structure?
questions.answer: Its role is to present four important matters before the Stations.

questions.question: What is the focus of the First Station?
questions.answer: The Arabic exposition.

questions.question: What is the focus of the Second Station?
questions.answer: The translated exposition together with the proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer admit about his original intention for the Introduction?
questions.answer: He admits he did not mean for it to become so long.

questions.question: What explanation is given for why the Introduction became lengthy?
questions.answer: Its length is taken as a sign that such explanation was needed.

questions.question: How does the final Qur’anic verse help frame the message of the passage?
questions.answer: It places the whole discussion within the larger purpose of worshipping Allah.

questions.question: Even after mentioning several causes of difficulty earlier, what judgment is made here about the treatise itself?
questions.answer: It is judged to be extremely important.

questions.question: What special kind of knowledge is Imam Ali said to have had about the work?
questions.answer: He is said to have had miraculous foreknowledge of it.

questions.question: What do the two names given to the treatise help readers understand?
questions.answer: They help readers see it as a distinguished and honored part of the larger work.

questions.question: How is Imam Ali’s connection to this treatise described beyond simply naming it?
questions.answer: He is described as showing special approval for it and guiding attention toward it.

questions.question: What happened because the book was printed in secret?
questions.answer: That action resulted in imprisonment.

questions.question: According to the note, what helped bring freedom after the imprisonment?
questions.answer: The triumph of the book’s holy and powerful truth helped bring release.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from the Denizli events?
questions.answer: It concludes that they confirmed the earlier prediction.

questions.question: What additional spiritual point is made through mention of the prayer?
questions.answer: The passage suggests that the prayer offered on their behalf was accepted.

questions.question: In relation to the Qur’an, what function does the Supreme Sign have?
questions.answer: It explains a great verse.

questions.question: In relation to the Risale-i Nur, what function does it have?
questions.answer: It forms the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How is the content of the treatise divided?
questions.answer: It is divided into an Introduction plus two Stations.

questions.question: What does each main part contribute?
questions.answer: The Introduction gives four key matters, the First Station gives the Arabic exposition, and the Second Station gives the translation with proofs.

questions.question: What attitude does the writer show toward the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: He is humble about it and says the length came from need, not from wanting to stretch it out.

questions.question: What does the statement that some may still find it too short reveal about the topic?
questions.answer: It reveals that the topic is rich and may require even more explanation for some readers.

questions.question: What truth about creation is stated at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Jinn and human beings were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: What overall claim is made about this treatise at the beginning of the target passage?
questions.answer: The claim is that the treatise has very great importance.

questions.question: Which early Muslim figure is mentioned to support that claim?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: How does the passage say he honored this work?
questions.answer: By foretelling it, naming it, and showing it special favor.

questions.question: Why is the mention of two titles important for comprehension of the passage?
questions.answer: It shows the same work is being described in more than one honored way.

questions.question: What circumstance connected to the book caused hardship for its people?
questions.answer: Its secret printing caused their imprisonment.

questions.question: What positive outcome followed that hardship according to the passage?
questions.answer: They were acquitted and delivered.

questions.question: What was said to be the main reason for that positive outcome?
questions.answer: The power and victory of the book’s sacred truth.

questions.question: What can a reader infer from the way the passage links imprisonment and release to the same book?
questions.answer: The book became a means of trial first and then a means of vindication.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by calling the Supreme Sign an exposition?
questions.answer: It means the work explains and unfolds the meaning of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What numbered place does this work hold within the Rays?
questions.answer: It is the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What are the internal parts of the treatise named here?
questions.answer: An Introduction, a First Station, and a Second Station.

questions.question: What makes the First Station different in language from the Second Station?
questions.answer: The First Station is in Arabic, while the Second Station presents a translation.

questions.question: Besides translation, what else is included in the Second Station?
questions.answer: Supporting proofs are included too.

questions.question: Why does the writer believe the long Introduction is justified?
questions.answer: Because its length points to a real need for that much explanation.

questions.question: How does the closing Qur’anic verse summarize the deepest purpose behind the whole discussion?
questions.answer: It reminds the reader that the purpose of creation for jinn and mankind is worship of Allah.
